reviewItem.question: Does "Disable Structured Metadata (and therefore OTLP support) and upgrade to 3.0 and perform the schema migration after" mean a change to migration:loki|name=disable-structured-metadata-before-upgrade (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: The upgrade guide describes a migration path for 3.0: disable structured metadata (allow_structured_metadata: false in limits_config, or -validation.allow-structured-metadata=false), upgrade to 3.0, then perform the schema migration.
